title: hadith-commentary-agents: Code and Run Manifests for "Reading over the Commentator's Shoulder"
description: Code, prompts, run manifests and evaluation scores for the DH2027 long paper "Reading over the Commentator's Shoulder: How AI Agents Derive and Use the Methods of Sunni and Shīʿī Ḥadīth Commentators". The release contains the Study-Agent and Query-Agent pipeline, tests, scripts, Slurm jobs, run manifests and evaluation scores. Third-party corpus texts are not included; data/README.md explains how to obtain them.
